body: apps/desktop UI was invisible/unstyled ('no controls, themes not working at all') because styles.css only imported tailwindcss + @filemark/mdx/styles.css. The shadcn design tokens (:root/[data-theme] --background/--foreground/--muted/--border + the Tailwind v4 @theme inline --color-* mapping + @custom-variant dark) live ONLY in apps/chrome-ext/src/styles/index.css, NOT in @filemark/mdx. Without that block every bg-background/text-foreground/border/bg-muted utility resolves to nothing. Fix: port the full 200-line token layer from chrome-ext/src/styles/index.css into the new host's stylesheet (+ @source the packages glob at correct depth, + tw-animate-css). Verified: built renderer CSS went tiny→145KB with .bg-background/.bg-sidebar/[data-theme] rules present. Any future host (VS Code webview, etc.) must do the same.
title: New filemark host app must port the shadcn token CSS layer, not just import @filemark/mdx styles
